decisions.reason: The judge duplicates the source when taking cones of the two components separately. By the cochain cone formula (Stacks, Definition 13.9.1), Cone(f_a) is k^2 -> k in degrees -1,0 with differential (b,c) -> ac. For a nonzero it splits as S[1] plus the contractible complex k --a--> k; for a=0 it is S plus two copies of S[1]. Hence exactly q-1 maps have cone y. Aut(S) has order q-1, and Ext^{-1}(S,z)=k is the only nonzero negative Ext in the coefficient ratio. Toën Proposition 5.1 therefore gives g=1/q whereas n=1, exactly as claimed.
